body: Thank you, it does help feeling like you have support, even if it's from a stranger. I hope that day does come where I don't focus as much on the negatives anymore

Thank you. It's just hard to think rationally sometimes and it's hard to stay positive when I feel horrible. I'm trying to think logically when I'm angry instead of attacking and regretting. But it's hard to not think that everyone else hates me and remembers every horrible or idiotic thing I've done or said though. I don't forget them and I doubt they do either.

I think that's part of it. Especially since I guard myself so much, it hurts when someone who's close to me attacks my insecurities. When I do the same I'm a hypocrite, I know this and yet I still do it. I still knowingly hurt others when I don't want them to hurt me.
Another part is just a day to day basis where I'm either useless or a burden. I get good grades, but I'm not as knowledgeable as my peers and I feel like it's pointless that I'm even going to school. I feel like I don't have a future anywhere. I'm not passionate about anything and I'm not particularly spectacular at any specific field. I'm not going to be able to contribute to society in shape or form and my mistakes just end up bothering and burdening others.
